scope: These are observed conditions of the M70 actions, not portable deadlines or proof that removing one operator preserves targeting or healing competition.

roadblocks.protected_passage: #14 blocked by trap2 from 3620 until 10787; #3 blocked by trap1 from 2773 until 11017

operator_rows.name: 芬
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@0 for 10 DP; 9 blocks, 17538.75 damage, 9 kills, including #21 and #33. No death or retreat.
operator_rows.replacement_space: Need another economic opener plus live blocking for #1/#6/#10/#12/#19/#27/#29/#33 or a structural change covering those windows.

operator_rows.name: Friston-3
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@91 for 3 DP; 9 blocks, 4098.4 damage, no kill credit, 17510 incoming. Held #22@4796-6429, #28@5871-6681, #31@6081-6886, and #34@6596-7197.
operator_rows.replacement_space: The late simultaneous #28/#31/#34 queue is the key risk; replacement must supply three-capacity blocking, enough survival, and arts output overlap.

operator_rows.name: 月见夜
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@571 for 16 DP; 7 blocks, 51798.74 damage, 12 kills, with skills@1772 and 5073.
operator_rows.replacement_space: A substitute must cover many officers plus #28/#31; physical armor may make raw attack value insufficient.

operator_rows.name: 玫兰莎
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@841, destroyed trap4@1966, retreated@2054 with refund; returned@4155, dealt 24312.36, killed #21@5154 and #27@5839, destroyed trap2@10787, then returned again@10202.
operator_rows.replacement_space: Opening trap4, early officer kills, #21/#27 damage, trap2 timing, and late western deployment all need substitutes if removed.

operator_rows.name: 安赛尔
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@1321; healed 25339.10 total, including 10256.10 to Friston, 5169.80 to Steward, and 2690 to Fang. No death.
operator_rows.replacement_space: Effective HPS in late #28/#31/#34 overlap matters; probability extra heal is unsupported.

operator_rows.name: 芙蓉
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@1681; healed 20156.80 total, including 7253.90 to Friston and 2110.20 to Steward. No death.
operator_rows.replacement_space: A single healer replacement must handle the same target competition and artillery recovery, not merely match total healing.

operator_rows.name: 斑点
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@2341 after Melantha retreat; 5 blocks, 13090 damage, 4 kills, 4493.60 healing (2794.10 to Ansel and 1699.50 self). Held lower officers #16/#18/#24/#26/#32.
operator_rows.replacement_space: Could merge damage/block/self-sustain or be replaced, but lower-lane officer queue and #32 timing must stay covered.

operator_rows.name: 史都华德
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@2071 for 18 DP, killed artillery@4273 after 13227.21 damage, retreated@4280; returned@6381, killed #22@6429 and #34@7197, then retreated@8100. Total 22289.47 damage and 4 kills.
operator_rows.replacement_space: Artillery timing, #22/#34 arts overlap, and later trap1 closure must be preserved or deliberately restructured.

optimization_instruction: Do not merely remove or retain a named operator. Compare faster kill/contact, rotation/handoff, and repositioned blocking/fire support. Verify target selection, real contact windows, mixed physical/arts damage, healing competition, retreat/refund/redeploy cooldown, and released enemies.
